definition: Tangle is an infrastructure company for AI agents, with a product lab and a research lab.
evaluation: Native capability in every infrastructure layer and product, not a separate infrastructure layer.
thesis: Sell infrastructure for AI agents. Products and research use the same layers to test and prove it.

products.name: Sandbox
products.does: Creates reproducible workspaces for coding agents, tests, browser tasks, files, terminals, and snapshots.

products.name: Router
products.does: Routes OpenAI-compatible calls across providers with fallback, policy, health, and one API key.

products.name: Browser Agent
products.does: Runs real Chromium from a goal and captures screenshot, DOM, and step evidence.

products.name: Agent Eval
products.role: evaluation library used within products and infrastructure
products.does: Scores traces and compares candidate behavior against selected cases.

products.name: Blueprint Agent
products.does: Builds, tests, evaluates, and packages agent services from one workbench.

products.name: Blueprint catalog
products.does: Indexes separate Blueprint services built for the Tangle protocol.

products.name: Hosted assistants
products.does: Previews a hospitality guest-request workflow; the full request-to-resolution flow is still being tested.
